systems.system: DGI primary and backup data centres (SIGIT)

CMR.note: The notice is a tender for equipment for the tax directorate's primary and backup data centres; it names no place and no site in service.
The DGI data centres are the tax directorate's own and a tender for equipment; none stated as renting to others.
The DGI primary and backup data centres serve the tax directorate itself and are not stated as for hire.
The SIGIT tax system is named only as the reason for a data-centre equipment tender; no electronic payment stated.
